text:
maya: Quick preflight check — need a fast roll-call for the SDK/docs/sampleapps release window. Changelog cutoff is EOD Thursday PST. Who's owning final sampleapp smoke and the changelog merge?

sam: I can own SDK changelog entries and the release notes section.

leo: I'll take docs sanity pass (quick links, API snippets). Can someone ping me when sampleapp PRs land?

maya: thanks. @sam do you have the canonical changelog format? want to avoid bikeshedding at the last minute.

sam: yes — use this snippet for entries:```- SDK: v1.4.0 — fix: respect streaming backpressure; add test for retry jitter```

ari: I can do sampleapp smoke on Wednesday afternoon (US-EAST). 2 quick checks: env vars and readme anchor links. estimate 1.5h.

maya: perfect. important: sampleapps must pass CI with the new SDK tag and the quickstart README must include the new install snippet.

leo: noted. I'll watch the README changes. If anyone updates the install, please use the single-line pip example: `pip install redwood-inference==1.4.0`

ci-bot: CI status: sampleapp-tests queued (PR #472, PR #474). flaky-tests flagged: `sampleapp/integration/test_streaming.py` - rerun recommended.

ari: re: flaky test — I can add a retry in the test harness today. will open PR and tag @sam once ready.

tanya: FYI product: enterprise customers expect the SDK changelog to call out the dedicated routing fix. please ensure wording mentions routing fallback mitigation.

sam: will include: "fix: ensure smart routing fallback respects latency policy; avoids silent fallback to low-tier model"

maya: owner recap: sam = changelog + release notes, leo = docs final pass, ari = sampleapp smoke & flaky test fix, maya = cutover approvals. If PRs land, drop links here and call out anything > 30m risk.

ari: opening PR for flaky test fix now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapps/pull/475 — tagging @sam @leo

sam: looking. if CI passes, i'll merge changelog entries by EOD Thurs.

leo: will do a doc pass Wed evening. flagging one nit: quickstart code block needs explicit `client.close()` in streaming example.

maya: good catch. small ask: anyone planning a last-minute API surface change? if yes, stop — we only accept docs/packaging/README edits.

sam: no API changes. only internal bugfixes and changelog text.

maya: great. i'll keep watch and approve once CI green. thanks team :thumbsup:

ci-bot: PR #475 — build passed (linux/py3.11). sampleapp-tests: all green.

ari: merged the fix and updated the README anchor.

sam: merged changelog PR and updated release notes draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xx... (DM if you need edit access)

leo: did docs pass — quick confirm?

maya: leo approved in the doc tracker. we're good to ship unless anything else pops up.

maya: final: changelog cutoff met, sampleapps smoke done, docs pass. releasing tomorrow morning unless I hear blockers by EOD PST.

ari: noted. thanks all.

sam: thanks! :rocket:
